description: This file contains declarations for the IEEE 1905.1/1a data model API, including functions for initialization, device and network topology management, interface handling, and external data retrieval within a broadband networking stack.

methods.name: DMinit
methods.description: Initializes the data model before any other functions are called.

methods.name: DMfini
methods.description: De-initializes or cleans up the data model resources.

methods.name: DMalMacSet
methods.description: Sets the AL MAC address in the database.

methods.name: DMalMacGet
methods.description: Retrieves the AL MAC address from the database.

methods.name: DMregistrarMacSet
methods.description: Sets the registrar MAC address.

methods.name: DMregistrarMacGet
methods.description: Retrieves the registrar MAC address.

methods.name: DMmapWholeNetworkSet
methods.description: Configures whether to map the whole network or only neighbors.

methods.name: DMmapWholeNetworkGet
methods.description: Gets the current network mapping scope setting.

methods.name: DMfindInterface
methods.description: Checks if an interface with a given name and MAC address exists in the datamodel.

methods.name: DMinsertInterface
methods.description: Adds a new interface with a specific name and MAC address to the datamodel.

methods.name: DMmacToInterfaceName
methods.description: Retrieves the interface name associated with a MAC address.

methods.name: DMinterfaceNameToMac
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address associated with an interface name.

methods.name: DMupdateDiscoveryTimeStamps
methods.description: Updates timestamps for topology and bridge discovery messages received on interfaces.

methods.name: DMisLinkBridged
methods.description: Checks if a link is considered bridged based on recent topology or LLDP messages.

methods.name: DMisNeighborBridged
methods.description: Checks if a neighbor is bridged.

methods.name: DMisInterfaceBridged
methods.description: Checks if an interface is bridged.

methods.name: DMmacToAlMac
methods.description: Returns the AL MAC address owning a specific interface MAC.

methods.name: DMupdateNetworkDeviceInfo
methods.description: Updates information about a network device in the data model.

methods.name: DMnetworkDeviceInfoNeedsUpdate
methods.description: Determines if a device's info should be refreshed based on last update time.

methods.name: DMupdateNetworkDeviceMetrics
methods.description: Updates metrics (link quality, etc.) for a device.

methods.name: DMdumpNetworkDevices
methods.description: Outputs all devices currently stored in the data model.

methods.name: DMrunGarbageCollector
methods.description: Removes stale entries from the data model based on age.

methods.name: DMremoveALNeighborFromInterface
methods.description: Removes a neighbor from a specific interface.

methods.name: DMextensionsGet
methods.description: Retrieves a list of vendor-specific TLVs for a device.
